name: cool-retro-term
description: A good looking terminal emulator which mimics the old cathode display...
readme_summary: Cool-retro-term is a terminal emulator that recreates the aesthetic of old cathode ray tube screens. It offers a visually appealing and customizable experience, mimicking the look and feel of vintage computer displays.
primary_use_case: To provide a nostalgic and visually distinctive terminal emulator experience by replicating the appearance of old CRT monitors.
cover_image_prompt: A time traveler sitting at a modern desk, but instead of a sleek monitor, they are using a glowing, retro cathode ray tube terminal. The terminal screen displays vibrant green text that seems to emanate a soft glow, reminiscent of old-school computer displays. Around the terminal, subtle digital particles and faint circuit board patterns float in the air, hinting at the underlying technology. The time traveler is typing on a vintage keyboard, looking pleased with the nostalgic interface. The scene is dimly lit, with the primary light source being the warm glow of the CRT screen, creating a cozy and immersive atmosphere. The overall style should be a digital painting with a focus on atmospheric lighting and clear, nostalgic details, with the 'cool-retro-term' name subtly integrated into a label on the terminal's casing.

name: gods-eye-view
description: A spy satellite simulator in your browser, except the data is real. Live open source spatial intelligence on a photorealistic 3D globe.
readme_summary: God's Eye View is a web-based spy satellite simulator that provides live, open-source spatial intelligence on a photorealistic 3D globe. It integrates real-time data from aircraft, ships, satellites, earthquakes, traffic, and public cameras, offering a hands-free voice control interface powered by an AI agent.
key_features: Live tracking of aircraft, ships, satellites, earthquakes, traffic, and public cameras
Hands-free voice control with a realtime AI agent
Voice-controlled annotations and drawing on the globe
Multiple visual sensor overlays (CRT, NVG, FLIR, Noir, Snow)
Detection overlay with bounding boxes and IDs
Extensible module system for adding custom data sources
Local browser execution without mandatory API keys
primary_use_case: Providing users with a real-time, interactive, and visually rich platform for exploring live global data streams, simulating a spy satellite's perspective for situational awareness and intelligence gathering.
cover_image_prompt: A stylized, semi-transparent spy satellite control console floating above a photorealistic 3D globe. The globe displays glowing, interconnected data streams representing live aircraft, ships, and satellite paths. A holographic hand hovers over the console, manipulating a specific flight path, while a subtle AI agent interface is visible on a side screen. The overall mood is one of advanced, accessible global surveillance and data synthesis. The art style should be a blend of futuristic UI design and realistic globe rendering, with a color palette of deep blues, greens, and glowing accent colors, evoking a sense of high-tech intelligence gathering. The repository name 'God's Eye View' is subtly integrated into the console's display.

name: netviz
description: A browser-based app for designing network architectures visually.
readme_summary: Netviz is a browser-based application for visually designing and animating network architectures. It allows users to add components, map data flow, and create animated request paths for presentations.
key_features: Drag and drop blocks or insert production templates
Build and tune custom request-flow animations
Preview animations with optional camera follow
Inspector panel to edit selected items
Custom blocks with your own icons
Local save with IndexedDB, no server needed
primary_use_case: Visually designing and animating network architectures in a browser.
cover_image_prompt: A whimsical, animated blueprint of a futuristic city's transportation network. Tiny, glowing vehicles representing data packets travel along intricate pathways connecting various buildings (servers, databases, proxies). A friendly, stylized architect character is shown using a magical stylus to draw new connections and animate the flow of traffic. Small, subtle UI elements resembling Netviz's interface are integrated into the scene, perhaps on floating screens. The overall mood is creative and dynamic, with a clean, bright aesthetic. The style should be a vibrant 3D isometric illustration, emphasizing the interconnectedness and flow of information.

name: claude-swarm
description: MCP server for orchestrating parallel Claude Code worker swarms with protocol-based behavioral governance, persistent state, and real-time monitoring dashboard
readme_summary: Claude Swarm is a TypeScript-based MCP server designed to orchestrate parallel Claude Code worker swarms for long-running autonomous coding sessions. It features persistent state management, Git worktree isolation, and protocol-based behavioral governance to ensure reliable and constrained AI-driven development.
key_features: Parallel Claude Code Workers via tmux
Worker Plan Mode with Competitive Planning
Real-time Web Dashboard with Server-Sent Events
primary_use_case: Orchestrating parallel AI coding agents for complex, long-running autonomous development tasks with built-in safety and monitoring.
cover_image_prompt: A conductor leading a highly synchronized orchestra of AI robots, each robot diligently writing code on individual digital screens. The conductor, representing the MCP server, uses a glowing baton to direct the flow of tasks and ensure harmony. Musical notes transform into lines of code, and the robots work within isolated, transparent workbenches. Subtle UI elements showing progress and protocol adherence are visible on the conductor's console. The scene is vibrant and futuristic, rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style, emphasizing collaboration and controlled execution.

name: drift
description: Terminal screensaver that activates when you're idle, constellations, rain, particles & more. Press any key to resume. Just drift away!
readme_summary: Drift is a terminal screensaver written in Go that transforms idle time into ambient visual art. It offers a variety of animated scenes and themes, activating automatically when the terminal is inactive and resuming upon user input.
key_features: 14 unique animated scenes (e.g., waveform, constellation, rain, particles, life, clock)
9 built-in themes matched to popular terminal colorschemes
Automatic activation on idle and resumption on key press
primary_use_case: Enhancing the aesthetic appeal of a terminal during periods of user inactivity by displaying dynamic, artistic animations.
cover_image_prompt: A serene, dimly lit computer terminal screen displaying a mesmerizing, slowly evolving cosmic nebula. Tiny, glowing particles representing idle time drift into the nebula, causing it to subtly shift and form intricate patterns. In the foreground, a single, stylized keyboard key glows faintly, hinting at the user's ability to instantly resume activity. The overall mood is tranquil and artistic, suggesting a peaceful transformation of inactivity into beauty. The style should be a blend of digital painting and abstract art, with a focus on soft, glowing light and smooth transitions, subtly incorporating the 'drift' name in a stylized, almost ethereal font within the nebula itself.

name: ghgrab
description: A simple, pretty terminal tool that lets you browse and download files from GitHub, GitLab, Codeberg, Gitea, and Forgejo without leaving your CLI.
readme_summary: ghgrab is a terminal-based tool for browsing and downloading files from various Git forges like GitHub, GitLab, and Gitea. It offers a user-friendly TUI for efficient file selection, previewing, and batch downloads, eliminating the need for full repository clones.
key_features: Browse and download files/folders from GitHub, GitLab, Codeberg, Gitea, Forgejo
TUI interface for easy navigation and selection
Fuzzy search for quick file finding
GitHub release artifact downloads with OS/architecture selection
Installable via NPM, Cargo, pipx, Nix, and AUR
primary_use_case: To efficiently browse and download specific files or folders from remote Git repositories directly from the command line without performing a full clone.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly, stylized robot arm in a clean, minimalist workshop, delicately plucking specific, glowing components (files and folders) from a large, intricate blueprint of a software project (GitHub/GitLab repository). The robot arm is placing these selected components into a small, organized toolbox labeled 'ghgrab'. In the background, a full, unselected blueprint remains untouched, emphasizing that only specific parts are taken. Subtle digital particles and data streams flow around the robot arm, indicating the transfer. The overall mood is efficient and precise, with a bright, clean aesthetic. 3D isometric illustration style.
